verdict.rationale: Braintrust exposes a full API and SDK to create/manage datasets and experiments programmatically (docs-31, docs-34, docs-41), an Eval() function to trigger runs from code (braintrust-gh-1/2, docs-38), and a documented MCP server plus CLI (`bt`) letting agents author scorers, run evals, and query/read back logs and results (docs-9, docs-25, docs-26, docs-33, probe-4, probe-5). This covers the full loop: dataset creation, programmatic eval trigger, and result readback via agent tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification (beyond vendor docs) that an agent end-to-end performs all three steps in one workflow, and no explicit example showing dataset creation specifically via MCP/CLI rather than just via SDK.
